componentPlan.focusQuote: If we incline the ladder so that its base is 2 feet from the wall, the ladder forms an angle of nearly 75.5 degrees degrees with the ground.
componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Walks through ladder measurements in page order to show how angle fixes side ratios

overview.headline: Right triangle sine cosine tangent ratios shown with ladder examples

keyPoints.point: The ratio of the sides of a right triangle depends only on the value of the angle
keyPoints.quote: the ratio of the sides of a right triangle depend only on the value of the angle “c".

keyPoints.point: Sine is defined as the ratio of the opposite side to the hypotenuse
keyPoints.quote: We will call the ratio of the opposite side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse the sine and give it the symbol sin.

keyPoints.point: Cosine is the ratio of the adjacent side to the hypotenuse for angle c
keyPoints.quote: The ratio of the adjacent side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse is called the cosine and given the symbol cos.

keyPoints.point: Tangent is the ratio of the opposite side to the adjacent side
keyPoints.quote: Finally, the ratio of the opposite side to the adjacent side is called the tangent and given the symbol tan.

keyTerms.gloss: longest side opposite the right angle
keyTerms.quote: We define the side of the triangle opposite from the right angle to be the hypotenuse.

keyTerms.gloss: side across from angle c labeled o
keyTerms.quote: There is a side opposite the angle c which we label o for “opposite”.

keyTerms.gloss: remaining side forming angle c with hypotenuse
keyTerms.quote: The remaining side we label a for “adjacent”.

keyTerms.gloss: ratio of opposite side to hypotenuse
keyTerms.quote: We will call the ratio of the opposite side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse the sine and give it the symbol sin.

keyTerms.gloss: ratio of adjacent side to hypotenuse
keyTerms.quote: The ratio of the adjacent side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse is called the cosine and given the symbol cos.

keyTerms.gloss: ratio of opposite side to adjacent side
keyTerms.quote: Finally, the ratio of the opposite side to the adjacent side is called the tangent and given the symbol tan.
